environment_caveat: Shared VM ~1.5 vCPU / 6 GB RAM; other rollout builds ran concurrently during setup and the cargo package-cache lock serialized builds. Absolute numbers carry load noise (wide CIs, outliers reported by criterion: 6% / 4% / 16%); use for regression deltas on the same machine class, not cross-machine comparison.
hot_path: SQL parsing: Parser::parse_sql (tokenize + parse to AST) — the entry point of every query/DDL statement
scope: Leaf crate only: risingwave_sqlparser (src/sqlparser) of the RisingWave mega-workspace. Full ./risedev build intentionally not attempted. The upstream sqlparser_bench crate (src/sqlparser/sqlparser_bench) is orphaned (not a workspace member) and cannot be built; this baseline adds an equivalent bench inside the member crate risingwave_sqlparser (src/sqlparser/benches/parse_bench.rs), reusing its two fixed SQL inputs verbatim (adapted to the dialect-free Parser::parse_sql API) plus one streaming-DDL case.
